temporal_carrier.window_selection: Exact symmetric offsets around every already-frozen reference and query anchor; no frame may be replaced or dropped after depth access.
temporal_carrier.mask: provider instance mesh z-buffer-visible pixels for the frozen target at each temporal frame
temporal_carrier.fusion: transform each accepted sensor point with its provider camera-to-world pose, concatenate all three registered clouds, then retain 4096 deterministic evenly spaced points in frame/raster order if necessary
temporal_carrier.portal_frame: fused reference observation centroid; principal horizontal direction in the SceneNN x-z floor plane; y upright
temporal_carrier.surface_score: unchanged negative symmetric median nearest-neighbour distance
temporal_carrier.zero_assignment: unchanged strict reciprocal row and column maximum
temporal_carrier.support: unchanged strictly positive registered planar convex-hull intersection; no IoU magnitude threshold

support_rule: unchanged strictly positive registered planar convex-hull intersection; no IoU magnitude threshold
claim_boundary: This consumed-scene posthoc experiment can establish only whether a minimal pose-registered temporal depth carrier makes the unchanged support mechanism evaluable and mechanically effective. It cannot supply fresh confirmation because the SceneNN scene, targets, anchors, and single-frame failure are already consumed. Instance masks, geometry and trajectories remain privileged; the sensor is not a phone. It is not raw-phone perception, door detection, aperture, named entrance, ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, user benefit, deployment, or safety evidence.
